semiconductor_relevance: High — Diosem, Inc. specializes in cleaning solutions and equipment maintenance for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Diosem, Inc. develops and provides cleaning best-known methods (BKM) for process equipment in the semiconductor and display industries. Their focus is on effective removal of process by-products and contamination control, ensuring optimal performance of manufacturing equipment.
capabilities: Chamber cleaning solutions for semiconductor and display vacuum chambers
Residue removal solutions for scratch-sensitive surfaces
Cleanliness inspection tools for identifying foreign materials

regional_presence.Korea: Diosem, Inc. is actively investing in both domestic and overseas markets, indicating a strong presence in Korea.
